name: Minimal reference tokens
purpose: Small semantic reference extracted from user-supplied website CSS. These are interface colors, not recovered map layer colors.
notes: Short hex values normalized to six digits.
UI color values retained as reference; map land, water, parks, geometry, and road styling are independently authored.
Dark-mode rules are deliberately excluded from this first light Minimal template.
Compiler flags, framework prefixes, layout rules, responsive utility classes, resets, and proprietary font/symbol references are excluded.
